title: Fair Supervised Learning Through Constraints on Smooth Nonconvex Unfairness-Measure Surrogates
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The study focuses on developing a new strategy for fair supervised machine learning by using hard constraints on smooth nonconvex unfairness-measure surrogates, with experiments conducted on datasets with sensitive attributes of gender and race.
